description: Comics Maker is an AI-powered comic creation studio for creators, educators, marketers, and teams who want to turn ideas into readable comic drafts without starting from a blank canvas. Users can begin with a simple scene, character concept, product story, classroom topic, or dialogue prompt, then use AI to shape it into comic panels, captions, layouts, and visual direction.
